fusions.name: Bound and Land
fusions.desc: You plant the staff and vault onto an enemy up to 7 tiles away. The landing deals 13 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Pogo Spin
fusions.desc: You bounce on the planted staff and spin, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, then move 10% faster for 2 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Across the Table
fusions.desc: You plant the staff and spring to a point up to 9 tiles away in an instant, then move 15% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Spring in the Stride
fusions.desc: Each stretch of ground you cover on the staff stores a spring: your physical damage rises 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
